messages.content: What are the calories of a Big Mac?

function.name: calculate_bmi

unit.description: The unit of measure. Defaults to metric units (kilograms/meters). Other option is imperial (pounds/inches).

message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly:

| Item | Calories |
|------|----------|
| Whole sandwich (including bun, beef patties, cheese, lettuce, pickles, onions, special sauce) | ~ 550 kcal |

> *This figure comes from U.S. McDonald’s nutritional data.*  
> In other markets the exact numbers may differ slightly due to regional ingredient or portion‑size adjustments—e.g., some European versions have around 540–560 kcal, while certain Asian variants might range between 520–580 kcal depending on local recipe tweaks.

If you’re tracking macros closely, it helps to check your specific country’s official McDonald’s website or ask at the counter; they’ll give you the most accurate breakdown for that location.
